bounded_objective: Prove GU' with absolute a and b<1 on the first internally non-disjoint extension of the quadratic-seed class: a full quadratic star sharing every data variable with a one-point defect, including all restrictions.
prior_status: Disjoint quadratic multiplication preserved an existing GU' constant, but arbitrary seeds had parameter-dependent constants and no shared star/defect family had a dimension-free class theorem.
mathematical_delta: Proved G<=8I (a=8,b=0), U<=8I, and H<=18I on an expanding restriction-closed shared-variable full-star point-defect class, with arbitrary disjoint affine-quadratic factors.

class_parameters.overlap: the defect shares all n data variables with the quadratic star

evidence.finite_scope: F_n through n=10; defect boundaries through n=14; exhaustive affine-quadratic disjoint factors through 3 variables against F_n through n=4

remaining_obstacle: The proof spends one parent U per coordinate and succeeds because U(F_n)=O(1) while I(F_n)=Theta(n). It gives no aggregate mismatch control for arbitrary changing coherent cores and reused coordinates through a hierarchy.
next_action: Analyze two quadratic star centres sharing the same point defect; either partition the mismatch into single-use pivotal edge classes or certify growth of G/I with the number of reused centres.
